metadata.description: An explicit edge to microsoft:build-base, NOT `^build`: `^build` would resolve to microsoft:build, which depends on this very target -- a hard cycle. The bundle compiles into the parent's dist directory (dist/packages/microsoft/cli), and the parent's `build` aggregates it, so this entry point has no `build` of its own.

msgraph.cli.bundle.spec.ts runs the BUILT bundle (dist/packages/microsoft/cli/index.js), so it is built first. The nx default test.dependsOn ["build"] names a target this entry point does not have (see build-base) and is skipped silently.
